question: Will the winning pumpkin at the 2026 Terminator weigh-off be greater than or equal to 2,000 pounds?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: winning weight at the PGVG Terminator weigh-off (Tualatin), the season's last weigh-off. Recent winners per BigPumpkins GPC tables: ~1729 (2022), 1677 (2023), ~1506 (2024), ~1628 (2025) — 0/4 at >=2000. 2026 is an exceptional Oregon year (Sherwood 2613 OR record, plus 2271, 2307, 2204, 2041 by OR growers), which raises the ceiling, but each of those pumpkins has already been weighed elsewhere and the Terminator gets leftover fruit; Half Moon Bay on Oct 12 will absorb more. Yes needs an unweighed ~2000 lb pumpkin (e.g., another Sherwood or Felten fruit). Market check: none found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.

calls.reasoning: Terminator winners hit >=2000 lb in 2 of 10 years (2016-2025), and 2023 missed by 2.5 lb. BigPumpkins 2023 data confirms Sherwood's 1997.5 won Terminator and was his best fruit that year, so Terminator does not always get leftovers. 2026 is the strongest Oregon season on record (five Oregon fruit over 2000 lb), which raises the chance an unweighed 2000+ fruit remains. Against that: Sherwood has already weighed four, Half Moon Bay may take big fruit first, Daletas looks absent, and no news shows a big pumpkin headed to Terminator. Slightly above the base rate. No market found.
calls.reconciliation: The runs disagreed on the 2023 Terminator winner: Run 1 had Clayton at 1677, Runs 2 and 3 had Sherwood at 1997.5. The BigPumpkins 2023 GPC list shows Sherwood's 1997.5 and 1947 lb fruit tagged Terminator and Clayton's 1677 below them. The 1947 tag may be a summarizer artifact, since the same list puts that fruit at Sacramento. Either way the base rate is 2/10, not 0/4, and in 2023 Sherwood's top fruit went to Terminator, which weakens the 'Terminator gets leftovers' argument. My search for 2026 Terminator entries or unweighed big fruit came back empty, and a direct fetch of the site-81 page timed out. Whether the record season outweighs Sherwood's already-weighed fruit plus Half Moon Bay is a judgment call; I lean slightly above the base rate.

disagreements.verdict: Sherwood's 1997.5 is the top entry tagged Terminator in the BigPumpkins 2023 data, so base rate 2/10, with a near miss in 2023
